title: Isikole nomsebenzi
description: Ten short, simple stories about school and work: a first day at school, a farm with few workers, a school football team, a shop and a kind seller, an office telephone, a school choir, a doctor, a beach clean-up, a father's leather shop and a footballer's wedding.

lessons.title: Usuku lokuqala lukaNomkhosi
lessons.summary: Little Nomkhosi starts grade one in Umlazi: her mother wakes her on Monday, she puts on her white school clothes, takes her new bag and goes to school until the last bell.
lessons.text:
UNomkhosi uyintombazane encane. Uhlala eMlazi nonina, uXolile. Kulo nyaka uNomkhosi uzoqala isikole. Unina umbhalisile esikoleni esincane endaweni yabo. UNomkhosi uzofunda ebangeni lokuqala.

Ngomsombuluko ekuseni kakhulu unina uyamvusa. Uthi: "Vuka, Nomkhosi! Namuhla uqala isikole." UNomkhosi uyavuka ngokushesha.

Unina umnika izingubo zesikole. UNomkhosi uyazigqoka. Ingubo yakhe imhlophe futhi intsha. Unina uthi: "Ingubo yakho imhlophe kakhulu. Uyintombazane enhle!"

Bese unina umnika isikhwama esisha. Uthi: "Faka izincwadi zakho kulesi sikhwama." UNomkhosi ufaka izincwadi zakhe esikhwameni. Isikhwama sakhe simnyama, kodwa ingubo yakhe imhlophe.

UNomkhosi nonina bahamba ngezinyawo baye esikoleni. Esikoleni kunezingane eziningi. Zonke zigqoke izingubo ezimhlophe, futhi zonke ziphethe izikhwama.

Ngehora 8 insimbi yesikole iyakhala. Unina uthi: "Uyezwa? Insimbi iyakhala. Manje kumele ungene esikoleni." UNomkhosi uyesaba kancane. Bese owesifazane ofundisa ibanga lokuqala uyeza. Uthi: "Ungesabi, Nomkhosi. Yiza nami." Unina uthi: "Hamba kahle, ntombazane yami."

Esikoleni uNomkhosi ufunda izinto eziningi. Ufunda ukubhala igama lakhe. Ufunda nokubala kuze kube yishumi. Ngehora 10 insimbi iyakhala futhi. Abafundi bayaphuma, badle ukudla kwabo. Ngehora 1 insimbi iyakhala futhi, futhi isikole siyaphela.

Unina umlindile ngaphandle kwesikole. Uyabuza: "Usuku lwakho lunjani?" UNomkhosi uthi: "Luhle kakhulu, Mama! Ngifuna ukubuya esikoleni futhi." Unina uthi: "Uzobuya. Ngizokuvusa futhi ekuseni kakhulu."

Imibuzo:
Unina ubhalise uNomkhosi esikoleni na?
Kunjalo, umbhalisile esikoleni esincane endaweni yabo.
UNomkhosi uzofunda ebangeni lokuqala na?
Kunjalo, uzofunda ebangeni lokuqala.
Ubani ovusa uNomkhosi ngoMsombuluko?
Unina uyamvusa ekuseni kakhulu.
Ingubo kaNomkhosi imhlophe na?
Kunjalo, ingubo yakhe imhlophe futhi intsha.
Insimbi yesikole iyakhala ngehora 8 na?
Kunjalo, iyakhala ngehora 8.

lessons.title: Insimu kaFezile
lessons.summary: Farmer Fezile in Nongoma has a big field but only three workers; he gives each a patch of hard ground to dig in the heat, while his son Mlondi drives the cows up the mountain.
lessons.text:
UFezile ungumlimi waseNongoma. Unensimu enkulu ngaphansi kwentaba. Unezinkomo eziningi futhi.

Kulo nyaka uFezile ufuna ukutshala ukudla okuningi ensimini yakhe. Kodwa unezisebenzi ezimbalwa kuphela: izisebenzi ezintathu. UFezile uthi: "Izisebenzi zami zimbalwa, kodwa insimu yami inkulu."

Ekuseni uFezile wenza izindima ezintathu ensimini. Unika isisebenzi ngasinye indima yaso. Uthi: "Le ndima ngeyakho. Lima umhlabathi wale ndima namuhla."

Umhlabathi uqinile kakhulu, ngoba amanzi mancane kulo nyaka. Izisebenzi zisebenza kanzima ezindimeni zazo.

Ukushisa kwelanga kukhulu. Izisebenzi zidinga amanzi. UFezile uletha amanzi ensimini. Uthi: "Phuzani amanzi. Ukushisa kukhulu namuhla."

Indodana kaFezile, uMlondi, ayisebenzi ensimini. UMlondi uqhuba izinkomo. Uziqhuba aye nazo entabeni. Entabeni kukhona ukudla okuningi kwezinkomo, futhi ukushisa kuncane lapho.

Ngemuva kwamahora amaningi uMlondi uqhuba izinkomo, zibuyele ekhaya. Izinkomo ziphuza amanzi ngaphandle kwendlu.

Ekugcineni izisebenzi ziqeda izindima zazo. UFezile ubheka insimu yakhe. Umhlabathi ulungile manje. Uthi: "Nisebenze kahle kakhulu. Ngosuku olulandelayo sizotshala."

UMlondi uthi: "Nami ngifuna ukusebenza ensimini." UFezile uthi: "Kulungile. Kodwa ukuqhuba izinkomo nakho kungumsebenzi omkhulu. Umlimi udinga izinkomo nensimu."

Imibuzo:
UFezile ungumlimi na?
Kunjalo, ungumlimi waseNongoma.
UFezile unezisebenzi eziningi na?
Cha, unezisebenzi ezimbalwa kuphela.
Isisebenzi ngasinye sithola indima yaso na?
Kunjalo, uFezile unika isisebenzi ngasinye indima yaso.
Umhlabathi uqinile na?
Kunjalo, umhlabathi uqinile kakhulu.
UMlondi uqhuba izinkomo aye nazo entabeni na?
Kunjalo, uziqhuba aye nazo entabeni.

lessons.title: Iqembu likaSmangele
lessons.summary: Coach Smangele trains a girls' school team in Soweto every Tuesday with a simple plan; in the big match they fall two points behind, keep trying, and beat the team from Umlazi.
lessons.text:
USmangele ungumqeqeshi esikoleni eSoweto. Uqeqesha iqembu lebhola lamantombazane. Uwaqeqesha njalo ngoLwesibili.

Ngolunye uLwesibili uSmangele uthi: "NgoLwesibili olulandelayo sizodlala nesikole esikhulu saseMlazi. Kumele sinqobe."

Amantombazane afika enkundleni yesikole. USmangele uyawaqeqesha amahora amabili. Uthi: "Nginesu. Isu lethu lilula: sizodlala njengeqembu elilodwa, futhi sizoshesha njalo."

USiphesihle ungumdlali omncane weqembu. Uthi: "Mqeqeshi, angidlali kahle njengabanye." USmangele uthi: "Lokho akulutho. Umzamo wakho mkhulu. Yenza umzamo njalo, futhi uzodlala kahle."

NgoLwesibili olulandelayo inkundla igcwele abantu. Abazali nabafundi bakhona. Benza umsindo omkhulu. Iqembu laseMlazi liqala kahle. Lithola amaphuzu amabili. Amantombazane kaSmangele awatholi lutho.

USmangele uthi: "Ningesabi! Khumbulani isu lethu. Dlalani njengeqembu elilodwa!" Amantombazane enza umzamo omkhulu. Athola iphuzu. Bese athola elinye iphuzu. Umsindo enkundleni mkhulu kakhulu. Ekugcineni uSiphesihle uthola elinye iphuzu!

Manje iqembu likaSmangele linamaphuzu amathathu. Iqembu laseMlazi linamaphuzu amabili kuphela. Amantombazane ahlule iqembu laseMlazi. Anqobile!

Amantombazane ayajabula kakhulu. USiphesihle uthi: "Ngiyajabula! Sinqobile!" USmangele uthi: "Nami ngiyajabula. Ninqobile ngoba nenze umzamo omkhulu, futhi nilandele isu lethu."

Imibuzo:
USmangele ungumqeqeshi na?
Kunjalo, ungumqeqeshi esikoleni eSoweto.
USmangele uqeqesha amantombazane ngoLwesibili na?
Kunjalo, uwaqeqesha njalo ngoLwesibili.
Isu likaSmangele lithini?
Lithi: "Sizodlala njengeqembu elilodwa."
Kukhona umsindo enkundleni na?
Kunjalo, kunomsindo omkhulu.
Amantombazane anqobile na?
Kunjalo, ahlule iqembu laseMlazi.

lessons.title: Izithelo ezinesici
lessons.summary: Kamogelo buys a hundred fruits at the small Johannesburg shop where Ndumiso works; some are bad inside, she brings them back, and Ndumiso kindly gives her fresh ones.
lessons.text:
UNdumiso usebenza esitolo esincane eGoli. Isitolo sidayisa izithelo. UNdumiso uthanda umsebenzi wakhe, futhi uthanda amakhasimende esitolo. Uwasiza ngomusa njalo.

UKamogelo uyikhasimende lesitolo. Uthenga izithelo lapho njalo. Namuhla uthenga ikhulu lezithelo, ngoba umndeni wakhe mkhulu. Ikhulu lezithelo lidinga isikhwama esikhulu!

Ekhaya uKamogelo ubheka izithelo. Izithelo eziningi zinhle. Kodwa ezinye izithelo ezimbalwa zinesici. Zimnyama ngaphakathi.

Ngosuku olulandelayo uKamogelo ubuyela esitolo. Ubuyisela izithelo ezinesici. Ukhombisa uNdumiso izithelo. Uthi: "Lezi zithelo zinesici. Zimnyama ngaphakathi."

UNdumiso uyazibheka. Uyaphawula: "Kunjalo, zinesici ngempela." Uthi: "Isitolo sizokubuyisela imali yakho."

UKamogelo uthi: "Hhayi, angifuni imali. Ngifuna izithelo ezinhle kuphela." UNdumiso umnika izithelo ezintsha ngomusa. Uthi: "Lezi zithelo zinhle. Akukho sici kuzo."

Indoda endala enesitolo ibona konke. Iyaphawula: "Ndumiso, usebenza ngomusa. Amakhasimende ayabuya esitolo ngenxa yomusa wakho."

UKamogelo uthi kuNdumiso: "Ngiyakubonga ngomusa wakho." Bese uthi: "Lesi sitolo sidayisa izithelo ezinhle, futhi abantu baso banomusa. Ngizobuya njalo." Ubuyela ekhaya nezithelo ezinhle.

Imibuzo:
UNdumiso usebenza esitolo na?
Kunjalo, usebenza esitolo esincane eGoli.
UKamogelo uthenga ikhulu lezithelo na?
Kunjalo, uthenga ikhulu lezithelo.
Ezinye izithelo zinesici na?
Kunjalo, ezinye zinesici. Zimnyama ngaphakathi.
UKamogelo ufuna imali yakhe na?
Hhayi, ufuna izithelo ezinhle kuphela.
Indoda enesitolo ithini?
Ithi uNdumiso usebenza ngomusa.

lessons.title: Ucingo lwehhovisi
lessons.summary: Thokozile answers the phones in a busy Durban office; at first the calls are too many for her, but at the office's Wednesday talk she suggests two people on the phones in the morning, and she soon gets used to the work.
lessons.text:
UThokozile usebenza ehhovisi eThekwini. Uqale lo msebenzi ngoLwesithathu. Ihhovisi likhulu, futhi linabantu abaningi.

Ihhovisi lisebenzisa uhlaka olusha lomsebenzi. Ohlakeni olusha umuntu ngamunye unomsebenzi wakhe. Umsebenzi kaThokozile ulula: uphendula ucingo, futhi ushayela amakhasimende ucingo.

Ekuqaleni lo msebenzi awejwayelekile kuye. Ucingo lukhala njalo! Amakhasimende amaningi ayashayela. Abanye bakhuluma ngokushesha kakhulu. UThokozile akezwa kahle.

Kunendoda endala ehhovisi, uMthobisi. Usebenza lapho kade. Uthi kuThokozile: "Uzokwejwayela. Phendula ucingo ngomusa. Bhala phansi amagama amakhasimende nezinkinga zawo."

NgoLwesithathu ihhovisi linomkhuba omuhle. Bonke abantu behhovisi bayahlangana. Benza ingxoxo ngomsebenzi wabo. Lo mkhuba muhle, ngoba bonke bayezwa izinkinga zabanye.

Engxoxweni uThokozile uthi: "Amakhasimende amaningi ayashayela ekuseni. Lawo makhasimende alinda isikhathi eside ocingweni." UMthobisi uthi: "Lowo ngumqondo omuhle. Ekuseni kuzoba nabantu ababili ocingweni."

Ngemuva kwenyanga uThokozile wejwayele umsebenzi wakhe. Uphendula ucingo kahle. Uyawazi amakhasimende amaningi ngamagama awo. Lawo makhasimende ayamthanda.

UMthobisi uthi: "Kade sidinga umuntu onomusa ocingweni. Manje sinawe." UThokozile uyajabula. Uthi: "Ngiyawuthanda umkhuba wehhovisi lethu. Ingxoxo yehhovisi ingisizile kakhulu, futhi uhlaka olusha luhle."

Imibuzo:
UThokozile usebenza ehhovisi na?
Kunjalo, usebenza ehhovisi eThekwini.
UThokozile uphendula ucingo na?
Kunjalo, uphendula ucingo, futhi ushayela amakhasimende.
Ihhovisi linomkhuba omuhle ngoLwesithathu na?
Kunjalo, ngoLwesithathu bonke benza ingxoxo.
Amakhasimende ayashayela ekuseni na?
Kunjalo, amaningi ayashayela ekuseni.
UThokozile wejwayele umsebenzi wakhe na?
Kunjalo, ngemuva kwenyanga wejwayele umsebenzi wakhe.

lessons.title: Ingoma engcwele
lessons.summary: Music teacher Ntobeko in Pretoria prepares her school choir to sing a hymn in a big church; quiet Nokwazi learns to raise her voice, and the choir takes third place.
lessons.text:
UNtobeko ufundisa umculo esikoleni ePitoli. Ufundisa iqembu lezingane umculo. Ngenyanga ezayo iqembu lizocula esontweni elikhulu, lapho abantu bakhonza khona uNkulunkulu. Izikole eziningi zizoba khona.

UNtobeko ukhetha ingoma engcwele. Uthi: "Le ngoma ingcwele. Abantu bayayicula esontweni lapho bakhonza uNkulunkulu."

Izingane ziqala ukucula. Kodwa ezinye izingane ziyakhuluma. UNtobeko uthi: "Thulani! Ngesikhathi somculo wonke umuntu kumele athule." Izingane ziyathula.

UNokwazi uyintombazane encane. Izwi lakhe lihle, kodwa alizwakali. UNtobeko uthi: "Nokwazi, phakamisa izwi lakho! Izwi lakho kumele lizwakale." UNokwazi uphakamisa izwi lakhe. Manje liyazwakala kahle.

Ngosuku lomculo bonke bafika esontweni. Abantu abaningi bakhona. UNtobeko uthi: "Ngiyethemba ukuthi sizocula kahle. Ninethemba na?" Izingane zithi: "Yebo, sinethemba!"

Izingane zicula ingoma engcwele. Wonke umuntu esontweni uyathula. Izwi likaNokwazi liyazwakala kahle kakhulu.

Ekugcineni iqembu likaNtobeko lithola indawo yesithathu. Izingane ziyajabula. UNtobeko uthi: "Indawo yesithathu inhle! Ngiyethemba ukuthi ngonyaka ozayo sizothola indawo yokuqala." UNokwazi uthi: "Yebo! Ithemba lethu likhulu."

Imibuzo:
UNtobeko ufundisa umculo na?
Yebo, ufundisa umculo esikoleni ePitoli.
Ingoma yezingane ingcwele na?
Yebo, ingcwele. Abantu bayayicula esontweni.
Izwi likaNokwazi liyazwakala ekuqaleni na?
Hhayi, alizwakali ekuqaleni.
UNokwazi uphakamisa izwi lakhe na?
Yebo, uyaliphakamisa, futhi manje liyazwakala.
Iqembu lithola indawo yesithathu na?
Yebo, lithola indawo yesithathu.

lessons.title: UTumelo nodokotela
lessons.summary: Young Tumelo cuts his hand on an old piece of metal; Doctor Refilwe in Soweto calms his breathing, puts medicine on the cut against infection, and warns him to be careful.
lessons.text:
URefilwe ungudokotela eSoweto. Usebenza esibhedlela esikhulu.

Ngolunye usuku umfana omncane, uTumelo, ufika esibhedlela nonina. UTumelo uyakhala. Isandla sakhe sinegazi. Unina uthi: "UTumelo udlale ngaphandle namuhla. Uthinte insimbi endala phansi. Akayinakanga. Insimbi isike isandla sakhe."

URefilwe ubheka isandla sikaTumelo. Insimbi isike isikhumba sesandla sakhe. Igazi liphuma esikhumbeni.

UTumelo uyesaba. Umphefumulo wakhe uyashesha. URefilwe uthi: "Ungesabi, Tumelo. Thatha umphefumulo omkhulu. Bese uthatha omunye umphefumulo." UTumelo uyakwenza lokho. Manje akesabi kakhulu.

URefilwe ubeka umuthi esikhumbeni. Uthi: "Lo muthi uzovimbela isifo. Insimbi endala ingaletha isifo emzimbeni. Kumele sivimbele lokho."

Bese uRefilwe unika unina omunye umuthi. Uthi: "Uma isandla sishisa, lo muthi uzokwehlisa ukushisa. Nika uTumelo umuthi ekuseni nasebusuku. Umuthi uzokwehlisa ukushisa ngokushesha."

URefilwe uyamyala uTumelo: "Qaphela izinto ezindala phansi. Qaphela insimbi njalo." Unina uthi: "Nami ngiyamyala njalo, kodwa akanaki." URefilwe uthi: "Umfana omncane akanaki zonke izinto. Ngakho kumele simyale njalo."

UTumelo uthi: "Dokotela, angeke ngiphinde ngidlale nensimbi endala. Ngizoqaphela." URefilwe uthi: "Kuhle. Uma uqaphela, angeke usike isandla sakho futhi."

Imibuzo:
URefilwe ungudokotela na?
Yebo, ungudokotela esibhedlela eSoweto.
Insimbi isike isikhumba sikaTumelo na?
Yebo, insimbi isike isikhumba sesandla sakhe.
UTumelo wayinaka insimbi na?
Hhayi, akayinakanga.
Umuthi uzovimbela isifo na?
Yebo, umuthi uzovimbela isifo.
URefilwe uyamyala uTumelo na?
Yebo, uyamyala: "Qaphela insimbi njalo."

lessons.title: Abafundi olwandle
lessons.summary: Teacher Sbonelo takes his Durban class to the sea to clean up what people have thrown away among the stones; Nyiko finds a long rope, and back at school the pupils write about the day.
lessons.text:
USbonelo ufundisa abafundi abadala esikoleni eThekwini. Ngolunye usuku uhamba nabafundi bakhe baye olwandle. Abafundi bazohlanza indawo yolwandle.

Olwandle kunezinto eziningi abantu abazilahlile: izikhwama, izingubo nezinto ezindala. USbonelo uthi: "Abantu abaqapheli. Balahla izinto zabo lapha, futhi izilwane zolwandle ziyafa ngenxa yalezo zinto."

USbonelo wenza amaqembu amabili. Iqembu elilodwa lihlanza uhlangothi olulodwa. Elinye iqembu lihlanza olunye uhlangothi.

Kunamatshe amaningi olwandle. Phakathi kwamatshe kunezinto eziningi abantu abazilahlile. USbonelo uthi: "Bhekani ngaphansi kwetshe ngalinye!"

UNyiko ungomunye wabafundi. Ngaphansi kwetshe elikhulu uthola intambo enkulu. Uthi: "Bhekani! Le ntambo inkulu kakhulu." USbonelo uthi: "Izilwane zolwandle zingafa ngenxa yezintambo. Yifake esikhwameni."

Ukushisa kukhulu. Nakuba umsebenzi unzima, abafundi bayajabula. Basebenza amahora amaningi. UNyiko uthi: "Izinto ziningi kakhulu. Sengathi azipheli!"

Ekugcineni bonke bayabheka. Izinhlangothi zombili zihlanzekile manje. UNyiko uthi: "Bheka ulwandle! Sengathi lusha."

Esikoleni uSbonelo uthi: "Lobani indaba ngosuku lwethu olwandle." UNyiko uloba indaba yakhe. Uyaloba ngamatshe, ngentambo nangezinto abantu abazilahlayo. Ekugcineni uloba: "Nakuba sisebenze kanzima, ngiyajabula. Angeke ngiphinde ngizilahle izinto zami olwandle."

Imibuzo:
Abafundi bazohlanza indawo yolwandle na?
Yebo, bazohlanza indawo yolwandle.
Abantu balahla izinto olwandle na?
Yebo, balahla izinto eziningi lapho.
UNyiko uthola intambo ngaphansi kwetshe na?
Yebo, uthola intambo enkulu ngaphansi kwetshe elikhulu.
Abafundi bayajabula na?
Yebo, nakuba umsebenzi unzima, bayajabula.
UNyiko uloba indaba na?
Yebo, uloba indaba ngosuku lwabo olwandle.

lessons.title: Ifa likaKagiso
lessons.summary: Old Kagiso makes leather bags in a little Soweto shop; his hands grow weak, so he leaves the shop to his daughter Dineo, teaches her the work, and she brings in more customers.
lessons.text:
UKagiso uyindoda endala eSoweto. Unesitolo esincane. Wenza izikhwama zesikhumba. Usebenze lapho iminyaka eminingi.

Manje izandla zakhe azinamandla, ngenxa yobudala bakhe. UKagiso uthi: "Ubudala bami bukhulu. Angikwazi ukusebenza kahle manje."

UKagiso unendodakazi, uDineo. UDineo uyamhlonipha uyise kakhulu. Ngolunye usuku uKagiso uthi kuDineo: "Ndodakazi yami, intando yami ukuthi uthathe isitolo sami. Lesi sitolo sizoba yifa lakho."

UDineo uthi: "Ngiyakuhlonipha, futhi ngiyalamukela lelo fa. Kodwa angazi ukwenza izikhwama. Ngiphe ithuba lokufunda."

UKagiso uthi: "Ngizokubonisa. Ngizokupha ulwazi lwami lonke. Lelo yifa lakho futhi."

Izinyanga eziningi uKagiso ubonisa uDineo umsebenzi. Umbonisa indlela yokusika isikhumba. Umbonisa nendlela yokwenza isikhwama. Uthi: "Sebenzisa ingqondo yakho, hhayi izandla zakho kuphela."

UDineo unengqondo enhle. Ufunda ngokushesha. Unemibono emisha. Wenza izikhwama ezinemibala eminingi. Amakhasimende ayazithanda. UDineo wandisa amakhasimende esitolo. Wandisa nemali yesitolo.

UKagiso uthi: "Ngiyajabula. Ingqondo yakho inhle kakhulu. Wandise ifa lami."

UDineo uthi: "Ngiyakubonga ngokuthi ungiphe lelo fa. Ngizolinakekela. Ngizokuhlonipha njalo."

Imibuzo:
UKagiso wenza izikhwama zesikhumba na?
Yebo, wenza izikhwama zesikhumba esitolo sakhe.
Izandla zikaKagiso zinamandla na?
Hhayi, azinamandla ngenxa yobudala bakhe.
Intando kaKagiso ithini?
Intando yakhe ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ithathe isitolo.
UKagiso ubonisa uDineo umsebenzi na?
Yebo, umbonisa indlela yokusika isikhumba nokwenza isikhwama.
UDineo wandisa amakhasimende na?
Yebo, wandisa amakhasimende nemali yesitolo.

lessons.title: Umshado kaNtsika
lessons.summary: Famous footballer Ntsika and his fiancée Sinoyolo decide to marry at home in Nongoma rather than in the big city; the family slaughters a cow, the food is spicy, the team's coach comes in person, and the couple kiss.
lessons.text:
UNtsika ungumdlali webhola odumile. Wonke umuntu eGoli uyamazi. Unentombi, uSinoyolo. Bafuna ukushada.

UNtsika uthi: "Ngidumile, futhi abantu abaningi bafuna ukubona umshado wethu. Singashada edolobheni elikhulu." USinoyolo uthi: "Mina ngifuna ukushada ekhaya, eNongoma, nemindeni yethu."

Bayacabanga isikhathi eside. Ekugcineni banquma ukushada eNongoma. UNtsika uthi: "Sinqumile. Sizoshada ekhaya."

Ngosuku lomshado umndeni kaNtsika uhlaba inkomo. Ukuhlaba inkomo kungumkhuba womshado. Amadoda ahlaba inkomo ekuseni kakhulu.

Abesifazane balungisa inyama yenkomo. Ukudla kuyababa kancane. Abantu abadala bayakuthanda ukudla okubabayo.

Intombi kaNtsika igqoka ingubo emhlophe. Ibukeka kahle kakhulu. UNtsika naye ubukeka kahle. Abantu bathi: "Lezi zingane zibukeka kahle!"

Umqeqeshi weqembu likaNtsika uqobo lwakhe ufika emshadweni. Abantu bathi: "Umqeqeshi uqobo lwakhe ukhona lapha! Udumile naye."

USinoyolo uthi kuyise: "Baba, ngiyajabula kakhulu namuhla." Uyise uthi: "Nami ngiyajabula, ndodakazi yami."

Ekugcineni uNtsika uyamanga uSinoyolo. NoSinoyolo uyamanga. Abantu bonke bayajabula. Bathi: "Manje nishadile!" UNtsika uthi kuSinoyolo: "Ngiyajabula ukuthi sinqume ukushada ekhaya."

Imibuzo:
UNtsika udumile na?
Yebo, ungumdlali webhola odumile.
UNtsika noSinoyolo banquma ukushada eNongoma na?
Yebo, banquma ukushada ekhaya, eNongoma.
Umndeni kaNtsika uhlaba inkomo na?
Yebo, uhlaba inkomo ngosuku lomshado.
Ukudla kuyababa na?
Yebo, kuyababa kancane.
Umqeqeshi uqobo lwakhe ufika emshadweni na?
Yebo, ufika emshadweni.
